## homebrew (darwin), en
A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
To update, run (it also refreshes the skills):
  brew update && brew upgrade agent-leeway && agent-leeway install-skills
The Homebrew formula is updated a few minutes after a release is published. If Homebrew still says agent-leeway is up to date, try again a little later.

## homebrew (darwin), ko
새 버전 0.1.6이 나왔습니다(지금 0.1.3). 릴리스 노트: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
업데이트하려면 다음을 실행하세요(스킬도 함께 새로 고칩니다):
  brew update && brew upgrade agent-leeway && agent-leeway install-skills
Homebrew 포뮬러는 릴리스가 나오고 몇 분 뒤에 갱신됩니다. Homebrew가 아직 최신이라고 하면 조금 뒤에 다시 해 보세요.

## scoop (windows), en
A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
To update, run (it also refreshes the skills):
  scoop update; scoop update agent-leeway; agent-leeway install-skills
The Scoop manifest is updated a few minutes after a release is published. If Scoop still says agent-leeway is up to date, try again a little later.

## scoop (windows), ko
새 버전 0.1.6이 나왔습니다(지금 0.1.3). 릴리스 노트: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
업데이트하려면 다음을 실행하세요(스킬도 함께 새로 고칩니다):
  scoop update; scoop update agent-leeway; agent-leeway install-skills
Scoop 매니페스트는 릴리스가 나오고 몇 분 뒤에 갱신됩니다. Scoop이 아직 최신이라고 하면 조금 뒤에 다시 해 보세요.

## scoop-global (windows), en
A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
To update, run this in a terminal opened as administrator, because it is installed for all users (it also refreshes the skills):
  scoop update; scoop update -g agent-leeway; agent-leeway install-skills
The Scoop manifest is updated a few minutes after a release is published. If Scoop still says agent-leeway is up to date, try again a little later.

## scoop-global (windows), ko
새 버전 0.1.6이 나왔습니다(지금 0.1.3). 릴리스 노트: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
모든 사용자용으로 설치되어 있으니, 관리자 권한으로 연 터미널에서 다음을 실행하세요(스킬도 함께 새로 고칩니다):
  scoop update; scoop update -g agent-leeway; agent-leeway install-skills
Scoop 매니페스트는 릴리스가 나오고 몇 분 뒤에 갱신됩니다. Scoop이 아직 최신이라고 하면 조금 뒤에 다시 해 보세요.

## installer (linux), en
A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
To update, run the installer again (it also refreshes the skills):
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/main/install/install.sh | sh

## installer (linux), ko
새 버전 0.1.6이 나왔습니다(지금 0.1.3). 릴리스 노트: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
업데이트하려면 설치 명령을 다시 실행하세요(스킬도 함께 새로 고칩니다):
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/main/install/install.sh | sh

## installer (windows), en
A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
To update, run the installer again (it also refreshes the skills):
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/main/install/install.ps1 | iex"

## installer (windows), ko

  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/main/install/install.ps1 | iex"
